Subject: Reminder: Punctuality and Professionalism

Dear Team,

I am writing to remind everyone of the importance of punctuality for client meetings. Being on time is a key reflection of our company’s professionalism and respect for our clients.

Recently, there have been several instances of tardiness that have been noted. This pattern is not sustainable and must be addressed immediately. Please take the necessary steps to ensure you arrive on time for all future engagements. Failure to do so may result in disciplinary action.

On a lighter note, while we focus on being precise with our time, let’s also appreciate the simple wonders around us, like how fluffy things in the sky rain comes from.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
